This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng: 
Ahmed Abd El Halim, tested by eng 
Hossam El Goweily, revised by quality control eng 
 عادل عبد القادر النجار at EDEPC, 
 accepted by general director eng 
Ahmed El Hussein and approved by 
 eng. Mohamed El Sarag Damietta PS head sector

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC MPIS Coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector

A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be well 
 trained , qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل.

Personal protective equipment must 
 be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses ... etc).

The operator, who is inside the 
 stator, is deprived from any metallic or magnetic object (kees, phones, tape 
 measure, chain ).

Protect the inferior part of 
 endwinding and core, with a rubber carpet or plastic film which will move with 
 a make progress expertise .

Supply of necessity, by 
 intermediate of separate cubicle, the eventual appliance, and lighting put on 
 work inside the core stator.
